name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow that routes through separately installed, role-pinned Luna and Terra custom agents and requires a fresh read-only Astra review.

interface.shortDescription: Architect with Astra, implement with role-pinned Luna or Terra, and review with Astra. Also known as Astra Advisor.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor, also known as Astra Advisor, gives Codex a capability-routed delivery workflow: GPT-6 Astra advises, plans, and orchestrates, separately installed role-pinned custom agents send routine work to GPT-5.6 Luna and harder work to GPT-5.6 Terra, and a fresh read-only GPT-6 Astra reviewer must approve the final diff.
defaultPrompt: Use Astra Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Route this implementation through the appropriate Sol Advisor lane.
Review this deliverable with a fresh Astra advisor before reporting done.
